title: LAMF Spine Event
description: Witness Spine event per DECISIONS.md §G. Canonical hashing (LAMF-CANON-1, see canonical-hashing.md) computes `hash` over the event minus `hash`/`sig`; genesis prev_hash = 64 ASCII zeros; sig = Ed25519 over the 32 raw hash bytes, base64url. seq is the ordering authority; ts is advisory.

seq.description: strictly monotonic per instance; the ordering authority

actor.description: actor_id of the single authenticated author (wire-protocol.md §5)

payload.description: inline payload, canonical size ≤ 4 KiB (DECISIONS.md §G). XOR with payload_ref.

payload_ref.description: sha256 key into payload_store; used when payload exceeds inline bound. XOR with payload.

payload_sha256.description: SHA-256 of LAMF-CANON-1 bytes of the payload content (identical inline or by-ref)

prev_hash.description: hash of event at seq-1; genesis = 64 ASCII zeros

hash.description: lowercase hex SHA-256 of LAMF-CANON-1 bytes of the event without hash/sig

sig.description: Ed25519 signature by the actor's key over the 32 raw hash bytes, base64url (RFC 4648 §5). Autonomous events authored by the well-known system actor 'lamf-system' are signed by the instance key (DECISIONS.md U-07).

channel.description: optional channel provenance (DECISIONS.md U-17/V3-11, T-channel-identity); channel metadata also marks paste/drop so pasted or file-dropped content is classified external_content (U-09c)

sanitizer_note.description: optional sanitizer annotation (DECISIONS.md U-15), e.g. a detector hit beyond the stored bound; keeps the sanitization gap auditable

capture_sig.description: optional hook-side Ed25519 signature produced at capture time, base64url (DECISIONS.md U-04; spool-format.md §2). Present in the deferred spool form and in finalized events when the adapter signed at capture. Distinct from `sig`, which is over the final chain hash.
